list_child.name: list_translation_jobs
list_child.desc: Returns the complete set of translation jobs currently tracked in the agency's project system, spanning every phase from intake through delivery. Use this whenever a full picture of the active job queue is needed.

get_child.name: get_translation_job
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single translation job record using its unique job identifier, returning every field currently stored for that job. This is the right call when the specific job in question is already known.

list_parent.name: list_clients
list_parent.desc: Returns the full roster of clients the agency currently has on file, regardless of how many jobs each one has open. Use this to get an overview of the entire client base.

get_parent.name: get_client
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single client record using its unique client identifier, returning the client's stored contact and account details. This is appropriate when the specific client is already known.

delete_child.name: delete_translation_job
delete_child.desc: Permanently removes a translation job record from the agency's system, an action that cannot be reversed once completed. This should only be used when a job entry was created in error or must be purged entirely.

set_enum.name: set_job_phase
set_enum.desc: Updates the phase of a translation job to reflect its current position in the pipeline, moving it between queued, in translation, in review, and delivered. Keeping this current ensures downstream reporting reflects the true state of the workload.

set_bool.name: flag_certified
set_bool.desc: Marks a translation job as requiring or having received certified translation status, which some legal and immigration documents require. This flag should be set whenever the client has requested a certified translation.

set_ref.name: reassign_client
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a translation job from one client account to a different one, which is useful when a job was logged under the wrong account. This updates ownership only and leaves every other job detail untouched.

send.name: email_client
send.desc: Sends a direct email to the client associated with a translation job, typically to notify them of a status change or request. This message goes straight to the client's own contact address on file.
